title: It Happened One Summer
author: Tessa Bailey
summary: A spoiled Los Angeles socialite is sent to a small fishing town after a scandal, where she has to work at a dockside bar run by a surly local. The city girl and the gruff bar owner clash, then slowly stop pretending to dislike each other.
readIf: you want a steamy, small-town, grumpy-and-sunshine story with a lot of banter.
skipIf: you prefer slow, quiet romances over big flirty heat and comic misadventures.

pairings.reason: Shares the quick, sparring dialogue and a hero who looks cold but is not.
Another romance with a stern, secretly warm hero who falls hard for the person he seems to resist.
A lighter, sunnier rom-com that keeps the bickering and gives it a beach setting.
